question: Which chapter and textual frame are concluded by this colophon statement?
premises: The statement marks the end of a section.
It names the Bhūtaśuddhitantra and the Hara-Gaurī dialogue.
It identifies the section as the twelfth chapter.
inference: This is the colophon of the twelfth chapter in the Bhūtaśuddhitantra, in the dialogue of Hara and Gaurī.
plain_english: Thus ends the twelfth chapter in the holy Bhūtaśuddhitantra, in the dialogue of Hara and Gaurī.
